venues.notes_summary: **DC — Sunday 2/15.** Slow start, pace picked up ~6pm and stayed steady to last call. Team proactive and communicative; tables flipped efficiently, no waitlist, all reservations seated on time. Kitchen: 15.6% of sales; big night for Bread & Butter (10 orders); demand high early so a few items 86'd earlier in the evening. MOD: Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.weather: Snow in second half of the night crimped sales
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 2/15.** Smooth, balanced, date-forward service (~2.2 guests/check); slowed after 11:30 but date-night waitlist until then; Max's shift #1. Chatty guests (choice paralysis, Blockbuster); Dante explained pulque distilado well. 4 solos, 4 large parties, 4 investor cocktails; comps $152.54. Weather: snow in the second half of the night crimped sales. Top sellers: Year of the Trees, First Time Listener, Buckhorn Exchange. Door: solid first three turns of mostly twos with a sprinkling of large groups; walk-ins dwindled as snow arrived ~11; Briggs, GM of Mister Paradise, visited. No cancellations or no-shows. Kitchen: snacks only.
